protocol: Training-only imputation/scaling/PCA; training references; test-only candidates. Each simulated user likes one aspect and avoids another relative to a seed. Oracle utility is mean signed cosine in standardized original aspect features; binary relevance is the top test-catalog utility quintile (ties included). Aspect consistency maps signed utility from [-1,1] to [0,1]. Avoidance counts disliked-aspect cosine <= 0. Macro means over users. Generic baseline uses cosine over all standardized audio feature columns. Labels share input features with the model: these are alignment diagnostics, not independent human relevance or causal evidence.
